description: When the seaside community of Amity finds itself under attack by a dangerous great white shark, the town's chief of police, a young marine biologist, and a grizzled hunter embark on a desperate quest to destroy the beast before it strikes again.

clues.LEVEL_1: When the seaside community of Amity finds itself under attack by a dangerous great white shark, the town's chief of police, a young marine biologist, and a grizzled hunter embark on a desperate quest to destroy the beast before it strikes again.
clues.LEVEL_2: A seaside community comes under attack by a great white shark. The town's police chief, a marine biologist and an experienced hunter set out to stop it before more people are killed.
clues.LEVEL_3: A community faces a deadly animal threat, but protecting its income delays efforts to keep people safe. A public official joins two specialists to pursue the danger directly.
clues.LEVEL_4: Someone responsible for others' safety struggles to act when acknowledging a danger would threaten the community's livelihood. As the cost of delay grows, an uneasy partnership takes the search for a solution beyond familiar ground.
clues.LEVEL_5: Protecting a community means confronting a danger it cannot afford to acknowledge.

description: Led by Woody, Andy's toys live happily in his room until Andy's birthday brings Buzz Lightyear onto the scene. Afraid of losing his place in Andy's heart, Woody plots against Buzz. But when circumstances separate Buzz and Woody from their owner, the duo eventually learns to put aside their differences.

clues.LEVEL_1: Led by Woody, Andy's toys live happily in his room until Andy's birthday brings Buzz Lightyear onto the scene. Afraid of losing his place in Andy's heart, Woody plots against Buzz. But when circumstances separate Buzz and Woody from their owner, the duo eventually learns to put aside their differences.
clues.LEVEL_2: A cowboy toy fears losing his owner's affection when a new space-themed toy arrives. His attempts to displace the newcomer leave both separated from their owner, forcing the rivals to work together to get home.
clues.LEVEL_3: A familiar plaything fears being replaced by a new arrival and tries to undermine the newcomer. When both become separated from their owner, their rivalry threatens their chance of returning.
clues.LEVEL_4: Someone accustomed to a secure place in a small community feels threatened by a newcomer who misunderstands their own importance. A struggle for recognition leaves both separated from the others, making cooperation their best chance of returning.
clues.LEVEL_5: Two rivals must cooperate to regain the place they competed over.

description: Eighties teenager Marty McFly is accidentally sent back in time to 1955, inadvertently disrupting his parents' first meeting and attracting his mother's romantic interest. Marty must repair the damage to history by rekindling his parents' romance and - with the help of his eccentric inventor friend Doc Brown - return to 1985.

clues.LEVEL_1: Eighties teenager Marty McFly is accidentally sent back in time to 1955, inadvertently disrupting his parents' first meeting and attracting his mother's romantic interest. Marty must repair the damage to history by rekindling his parents' romance and - with the help of his eccentric inventor friend Doc Brown - return to 1985.
clues.LEVEL_2: A teenage boy is accidentally sent decades into the past, where he disrupts his parents' first meeting and attracts his mother's romantic interest. He must bring them together and help an inventor find a way to send him home.
clues.LEVEL_3: A teenager accidentally travels into the past and interferes with the relationship that will lead to their own existence. Repairing that relationship becomes as urgent as finding a way back.
clues.LEVEL_4: An unexpected detour leaves a young person dependent on people who do not know what they mean to one another. An attempt to help complicates those relationships, and getting home requires repairing the disruption before an opportunity disappears.
clues.LEVEL_5: Getting back requires repairing a connection that one's arrival has put at risk.

description: A wealthy entrepreneur secretly creates a theme park featuring living dinosaurs drawn from prehistoric DNA. Before opening day, he invites a team of experts and his two eager grandchildren to experience the park and help calm anxious investors. However, the park is anything but amusing as the security systems go off-line and the dinosaurs escape.

clues.LEVEL_1: A wealthy entrepreneur secretly creates a theme park featuring living dinosaurs drawn from prehistoric DNA. Before opening day, he invites a team of experts and his two eager grandchildren to experience the park and help calm anxious investors. However, the park is anything but amusing as the security systems go off-line and the dinosaurs escape.
clues.LEVEL_2: A wealthy entrepreneur invites experts and his grandchildren to inspect a theme park filled with living dinosaurs. When its security systems fail, the visitors find themselves exposed to the animals they came to see.
clues.LEVEL_3: An entrepreneur invites specialists and relatives to assess an attraction built around animals recreated through scientific advances. A breakdown in the systems keeping them contained turns the visit into a struggle to survive.
clues.LEVEL_4: A small group is invited to assess an ambitious undertaking whose creator believes the hardest problems have already been solved. When carefully arranged safeguards unravel, the visitors must find a way out of something they were only meant to observe.
clues.LEVEL_5: Guests must survive the failure of something they were invited to admire.

description: Nemo, an adventurous young clownfish, is unexpectedly taken from his Great Barrier Reef home to a dentist's office aquarium. It's up to his worrisome father Marlin and a friendly but forgetful fish Dory to bring Nemo home -- meeting vegetarian sharks, surfer dude turtles, hypnotic jellyfish, hungry seagulls, and more along the way.

clues.LEVEL_1: Nemo, an adventurous young clownfish, is unexpectedly taken from his Great Barrier Reef home to a dentist's office aquarium. It's up to his worrisome father Marlin and a friendly but forgetful fish Dory to bring Nemo home -- meeting vegetarian sharks, surfer dude turtles, hypnotic jellyfish, hungry seagulls, and more along the way.
clues.LEVEL_2: A young clownfish is captured and placed in a dentist's aquarium. His anxious father searches for him with a friendly but forgetful companion, while the captive fish joins others planning an escape.
clues.LEVEL_3: A young creature is captured and confined with others far from home. An anxious parent searches with an unreliable but helpful companion, while those in captivity organize their own escape.
clues.LEVEL_4: A parent's efforts to prevent another loss are followed by a separation that demands unfamiliar risks. While an unexpected companion helps with the search, the missing child becomes involved in a different group's attempt to escape.
clues.LEVEL_5: A separation forces one to risk more and another to attempt an escape.

description: Young Dorothy finds herself in a magical world where she makes friends with a lion, a scarecrow and a tin man as they make their way along the yellow brick road to talk with the Wizard and ask for the things they miss most in their lives. The Wicked Witch of the West is the only thing that could stop them.

clues.LEVEL_1: Young Dorothy finds herself in a magical world where she makes friends with a lion, a scarecrow and a tin man as they make their way along the yellow brick road to talk with the Wizard and ask for the things they miss most in their lives. The Wicked Witch of the West is the only thing that could stop them.
clues.LEVEL_2: A young girl in a magical world travels with three unusual companions to seek help from a powerful figure. Each hopes to obtain something they lack, but a hostile witch threatens their journey.
clues.LEVEL_3: A young traveler in an unfamiliar world joins companions who each believe they lack something essential. They seek a powerful figure's help, but an enemy and a dangerous condition stand in their way.
clues.LEVEL_4: An unexpected upheaval leaves a young traveler seeking help in an unfamiliar place. Others join the journey with requests of their own, but the person they hope will solve their problems makes assistance conditional on a dangerous task.
clues.LEVEL_5: Several needs lead to one promise of help, offered on difficult terms.

description: When Dr. Indiana Jones – the tweed-suited professor who just happens to be a celebrated archaeologist – is hired by the government to locate the legendary Ark of the Covenant, he finds himself up against the entire Nazi regime.

clues.LEVEL_1: When Dr. Indiana Jones – the tweed-suited professor who just happens to be a celebrated archaeologist – is hired by the government to locate the legendary Ark of the Covenant, he finds himself up against the entire Nazi regime.
clues.LEVEL_2: An archaeologist is hired by the government to find an ancient sacred object before the Nazis obtain it. A former lover becomes his reluctant ally in a pursuit marked by traps, betrayals and repeated changes of possession.
clues.LEVEL_3: A researcher is commissioned to recover an ancient object before a hostile power can use it. A former partner becomes a reluctant ally as competing groups struggle to keep possession of their discovery.
clues.LEVEL_4: A specialist is sent to locate something that competing interests believe could give them an extraordinary advantage. The pursuit requires help from someone with reasons to resent them, while possession repeatedly proves less secure than it appears.
clues.LEVEL_5: Competing claims turn a search into a struggle to keep what is found.

description: A young lion prince is cast out of his pride by his cruel uncle, who claims he killed his father. While the uncle rules with an iron paw, the prince grows up beyond the Savannah, living by a philosophy: No worries for the rest of your days. But when his past comes to haunt him, the young prince must decide his fate: Will he remain an outcast or face his demons and become what he needs to be?

clues.LEVEL_1: A young lion prince is cast out of his pride by his cruel uncle, who claims he killed his father. While the uncle rules with an iron paw, the prince grows up beyond the Savannah, living by a philosophy: No worries for the rest of your days. But when his past comes to haunt him, the young prince must decide his fate: Will he remain an outcast or face his demons and become what he needs to be?
clues.LEVEL_2: A young lion prince flees after his uncle convinces him he caused his father's death. Raised away from the pride, he must decide whether to return when an old friend tells him what has happened under his uncle's rule.
clues.LEVEL_3: A young heir leaves after a relative assigns them blame for a parent's death. Life away offers freedom from responsibility until someone from the past reveals the consequences of the new ruler's reign.
clues.LEVEL_4: A young successor leaves home believing a devastating loss is their fault and builds a life apart from earlier expectations. An encounter with someone from that former life makes continued absence a choice with consequences for others.
clues.LEVEL_5: An escape from guilt becomes an absence others must live with.

description: Set in the 22nd century, The Matrix tells the story of a computer hacker who joins a group of underground insurgents fighting the vast and powerful computers who now rule the earth.

clues.LEVEL_1: Set in the 22nd century, The Matrix tells the story of a computer hacker who joins a group of underground insurgents fighting the vast and powerful computers who now rule the earth.
clues.LEVEL_2: A computer hacker discovers that everyday life is a simulation controlled by machines and joins a human resistance.
clues.LEVEL_3: A programmer discovers that familiar reality conceals a system of control and joins others fighting to escape it.
clues.LEVEL_4: Someone troubled by inconsistencies in ordinary life accepts help from outsiders, discovering that freedom requires questioning everything previously trusted.
clues.LEVEL_5: Escaping control begins with distrusting the familiar.

description: 101-year-old Rose DeWitt Bukater tells the story of her life aboard the Titanic, 84 years later. A young Rose boards the ship with her mother and fiancé. Meanwhile, Jack Dawson and Fabrizio De Rossi win third-class tickets aboard the ship. Rose tells the whole story from Titanic's departure through to its death—on its first and last voyage—on April 15, 1912.

clues.LEVEL_1: 101-year-old Rose DeWitt Bukater tells the story of her life aboard the Titanic, 84 years later. A young Rose boards the ship with her mother and fiancé. Meanwhile, Jack Dawson and Fabrizio De Rossi win third-class tickets aboard the ship. Rose tells the whole story from Titanic's departure through to its death—on its first and last voyage—on April 15, 1912.
clues.LEVEL_2: An elderly woman recalls a voyage aboard a doomed luxury liner, where a wealthy young woman meets a penniless passenger.
clues.LEVEL_3: A passenger revisits a journey on which people separated by social standing became connected before a catastrophe.
clues.LEVEL_4: A remembered encounter crosses boundaries of privilege during a journey whose promised opportunities give way to a struggle for survival.
clues.LEVEL_5: An unlikely connection forms before a shared catastrophe.

description: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: "inception", the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.

clues.LEVEL_1: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: "inception", the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.
clues.LEVEL_2: A thief who steals secrets through dreams is offered a way home if he can plant an idea instead.
clues.LEVEL_3: A specialist in entering sleeping minds accepts a task to influence someone, while personal memories threaten the operation.
clues.LEVEL_4: An expert accustomed to extracting private information must reverse the process, while unresolved personal attachments compromise a carefully organized operation.
clues.LEVEL_5: A specialist must influence another while escaping the past.

description: During its return to the earth, commercial spaceship Nostromo intercepts a distress signal from a distant planet. When a three-member team of the crew discovers a chamber containing thousands of eggs on the planet, a creature inside one of the eggs attacks an explorer. The entire crew is unaware of the impending nightmare set to descend upon them when the alien parasite planted inside its unfortunate host is birthed.

clues.LEVEL_1: During its return to the earth, commercial spaceship Nostromo intercepts a distress signal from a distant planet. When a three-member team of the crew discovers a chamber containing thousands of eggs on the planet, a creature inside one of the eggs attacks an explorer. The entire crew is unaware of the impending nightmare set to descend upon them when the alien parasite planted inside its unfortunate host is birthed.
clues.LEVEL_2: A spaceship crew investigates a distress signal and discovers eggs. A creature brought aboard threatens everyone.
clues.LEVEL_3: A working crew responds to a signal and unknowingly brings a deadly organism into a confined environment.
clues.LEVEL_4: An interruption to a routine assignment exposes a group to something they cannot safely contain, turning their means of returning into a trap.
clues.LEVEL_5: An attempt to investigate leaves a group trapped with danger.

description: An alien is left behind on Earth and saved by the 10-year-old Elliot who decides to keep him hidden in his home. While a task force hunts for the extra-terrestrial, Elliot, his brother, and his little sister Gertie form an emotional bond with their new friend, and try to help him find his way home.

clues.LEVEL_1: An alien is left behind on Earth and saved by the 10-year-old Elliot who decides to keep him hidden in his home. clues.LEVEL_2: A boy hides a stranded extraterrestrial and, with his siblings, tries to help it return home before authorities intervene.
clues.LEVEL_3: A young person shelters a stranded visitor and forms a bond while trying to arrange a return and evade pursuers.
clues.LEVEL_4: An unexpected arrival creates a private alliance, but outside intervention threatens both the relationship and the possibility of departure.
clues.LEVEL_5: Protecting a new bond may require helping someone leave.

description: In the post-apocalyptic future, reigning tyrannical supercomputers teleport a cyborg assassin known as the "Terminator" back to 1984 to kill Sarah Connor, whose unborn son is destined to lead insurgents against 21st century mechanical hegemony. Meanwhile, the human-resistance movement dispatches a lone warrior to safeguard Sarah. Can he stop the virtually indestructible killing machine?

clues.LEVEL_1: In the post-apocalyptic future, reigning tyrannical supercomputers teleport a cyborg assassin known as the "Terminator" back to 1984 to kill Sarah Connor, whose unborn son is destined to lead insurgents against 21st century mechanical hegemony. clues.LEVEL_2: A machine disguised as a man travels from the future to kill a woman whose unborn son will lead a resistance. A soldier follows to protect her.
clues.LEVEL_3: A future conflict sends an attacker and a protector into an earlier era, where one unsuspecting person becomes a target.
clues.LEVEL_4: Someone unaware of their future significance is pursued by an adversary and defended by a stranger, both acting on knowledge of events yet to happen.
clues.LEVEL_5: An ordinary life becomes the target of a future conflict.

description: Set ten years after the events of the original, James Cameron’s classic sci-fi action flick tells the story of a second attempt to get the rid of rebellion leader John Connor, this time targeting the boy himself. However, the rebellion has sent a reprogrammed terminator to protect Connor.

clues.LEVEL_1: Set ten years after the events of the original, James Cameron’s classic sci-fi action flick tells the story of a second attempt to get the rid of rebellion leader John Connor, this time targeting the boy himself. clues.LEVEL_2: A reprogrammed machine protects a boy from an advanced mechanical assassin sent to prevent his future leadership of a rebellion.
clues.LEVEL_3: A young future leader is pursued by an advanced attacker and guarded by a protector resembling an earlier enemy.
clues.LEVEL_4: An adversary with a familiar appearance becomes an unexpected ally against a more capable pursuer, complicating efforts to prevent a threatened future.

description: It ain't easy bein' green -- especially if you're a likable (albeit smelly) ogre named Shrek. On a mission to retrieve a gorgeous princess from the clutches of a fire-breathing dragon, Shrek teams up with an unlikely compatriot -- a wisecracking donkey.

clues.LEVEL_1: It ain't easy bein' green -- especially if you're a likable (albeit smelly) ogre named Shrek. On a mission to retrieve a gorgeous princess from the clutches of a fire-breathing dragon, Shrek teams up with an unlikely compatriot -- a wisecracking donkey.
clues.LEVEL_2: An ogre and a talking donkey set out to rescue a princess from a dragon, hoping to recover the ogre's secluded home.
clues.LEVEL_3: A solitary outsider agrees to retrieve a royal captive in exchange for reclaiming a home, accompanied by an unwanted companion.
clues.LEVEL_4: An attempt to restore a private way of life requires an unwanted partnership and a task that unsettles assumptions about those involved.
clues.LEVEL_5: Recovering solitude requires letting others in.

description: Lovable Sulley and his wisecracking sidekick Mike Wazowski are the top scare team at Monsters, Inc., the scream-processing factory in Monstropolis. When a little girl named Boo wanders into their world, it's the monsters who are scared silly, and it's up to Sulley and Mike to keep her out of sight and get her back home.

clues.LEVEL_1: Lovable Sulley and his wisecracking sidekick Mike Wazowski are the top scare team at Monsters, Inc., the scream-processing factory in Monstropolis. clues.LEVEL_2: Two monsters collect children's screams for power, but panic when a little girl enters their world and must be hidden.

clues.LEVEL_4: Two colleagues responsible for provoking fear must protect an unexpected visitor whose presence challenges what their community believes is threatening.

description: Carl Fredricksen spent his entire life dreaming of exploring the globe and experiencing life to its fullest. But at age 78, life seems to have passed him by, until a twist of fate (and a persistent 8-year old Wilderness Explorer named Russell) gives him a new lease on life.

clues.LEVEL_1: Carl Fredricksen spent his entire life dreaming of exploring the globe and experiencing life to its fullest. But at age 78, life seems to have passed him by, until a twist of fate (and a persistent 8-year old Wilderness Explorer named Russell) gives him a new lease on life.
clues.LEVEL_2: An elderly widower pursues a long-delayed adventure in a house lifted by balloons, accidentally bringing a young explorer along.
clues.LEVEL_3: A retired person sets out on a long-promised journey and discovers an unexpected young companion aboard.
clues.LEVEL_4: Someone trying to fulfill an old promise begins a journey in isolation, only to find an uninvited companion changing its purpose.
clues.LEVEL_5: An old promise leads to an unexpected responsibility.

description: What if mankind had to leave Earth and somebody forgot to turn the last robot off? After hundreds of years doing what he was built for, WALL•E discovers a new purpose in life when he meets a sleek search robot named EVE. EVE comes to realize that WALL•E has inadvertently stumbled upon the key to the planet's future, and races back to space to report to the humans. Meanwhile, WALL•E chases EVE across the galaxy and sets into motion one of the most imaginative adventures ever brought to the big screen.

Meanwhile, WALL•E chases EVE across the galaxy and sets into motion one of the most imaginative adventures ever brought to the big screen.
clues.LEVEL_2: A solitary waste-cleaning robot on an abandoned Earth follows a visiting robot into space after making an important discovery.
clues.LEVEL_3: A machine carrying out a lonely cleanup routine meets a visitor whose mission gives an ordinary discovery far-reaching significance.
clues.LEVEL_4: A solitary worker interrupts a familiar routine to follow a new acquaintance, carrying a discovery that could change the future of others.
clues.LEVEL_5: A lonely routine gives way to a consequential attachment.

description: Remy, a resident of Paris, appreciates good food and has quite a sophisticated palate. He would love to become a chef so he can create and enjoy culinary masterpieces to his heart's delight. The only problem is, Remy is a rat. When he winds up in the sewer beneath one of Paris' finest restaurants, the rodent gourmet finds himself ideally placed to realize his dream.

clues.LEVEL_2: A rat with a talent for cooking hopes to become a chef and finds an opportunity in a prestigious Paris restaurant.
clues.LEVEL_3: An animal with a refined sense of taste seeks a place in professional cooking despite being unwelcome in the workplace.
clues.LEVEL_4: Someone with an unexpected talent seeks entry to a respected profession whose basic assumptions exclude them, making recognition difficult to obtain openly.
clues.LEVEL_5: An unlikely talent seeks acceptance where it is unwelcome.

description: When 11-year-old Riley moves to a new city, her Emotions team up to help her through the transition. Joy, Fear, Anger, Disgust and Sadness work together, but when Joy and Sadness get lost, they must journey through unfamiliar places to get back home.

clues.LEVEL_1: When 11-year-old Riley moves to a new city, her Emotions team up to help her through the transition. Joy, Fear, Anger, Disgust and Sadness work together, but when Joy and Sadness get lost, they must journey through unfamiliar places to get back home.

clues.LEVEL_3: After a child undergoes a major life change, two personified emotions become lost and struggle to restore balance.
clues.LEVEL_4: A major change disrupts a carefully managed inner world, forcing contrasting influences to work together while those left behind struggle to cope.
clues.LEVEL_5: Restoring balance requires room for an unwelcome influence.

description: Despite his family’s baffling generations-old ban on music, Miguel dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol, Ernesto de la Cruz. Along the way, he meets charming trickster Hector, and together, they set off on an extraordinary journey to unlock the real story behind Miguel's family history.

clues.LEVEL_2: A boy from a family that forbids music enters the land of the dead and seeks answers about his musical ancestry.
clues.LEVEL_3: A young aspiring musician defies a family prohibition and encounters departed relatives while investigating a hidden history.

clues.LEVEL_5: A forbidden ambition exposes a disputed family history.

description: Young princess Anna of Arendelle dreams about finding true love at her sister Elsa’s coronation. Fate takes her on a dangerous journey in an attempt to end the eternal winter that has fallen over the kingdom. She's accompanied by ice delivery man Kristoff, his reindeer Sven, and snowman Olaf. On an adventure where she will find out what friendship, courage, family, and true love really means.

clues.LEVEL_1: Young princess Anna of Arendelle dreams about finding true love at her sister Elsa’s coronation. clues.LEVEL_2: A princess travels with an ice seller and his reindeer to find her sister, whose powers have trapped their kingdom in winter.
clues.LEVEL_3: A royal sibling seeks a withdrawn relative whose uncontrolled powers have caused a disaster affecting the whole community.

clues.LEVEL_5: A private estrangement becomes a shared crisis.

description: Follow the adventures of Belle, a bright young woman who finds herself in the castle of a prince who's been turned into a mysterious beast. With the help of the castle's enchanted staff, Belle soon learns the most important lesson of all -- that true beauty comes from within.

clues.LEVEL_1: Follow the adventures of Belle, a bright young woman who finds herself in the castle of a prince who's been turned into a mysterious beast. With the help of the castle's enchanted staff, Belle soon learns the most important lesson of all -- that true beauty comes from within.
clues.LEVEL_2: A young woman stays in a castle with a cursed prince and enchanted servants, gradually discovering more than his frightening appearance.
clues.LEVEL_3: A captive encounters a feared, transformed host and an enchanted household, where appearances conceal the possibility of change.
clues.LEVEL_4: An unwanted stay brings two isolated people into contact, challenging judgments formed before either understood the circumstances of the other.
clues.LEVEL_5: An unwanted encounter challenges a frightening first impression.

description: Princess Jasmine grows tired of being forced to remain in the palace, so she sneaks out into the marketplace, in disguise, where she meets street urchin Aladdin. The couple falls in love, although Jasmine may only marry a prince. After being thrown in jail, Aladdin becomes embroiled in a plot to find a mysterious lamp, with which the evil Jafar hopes to rule the land.

clues.LEVEL_1: Princess Jasmine grows tired of being forced to remain in the palace, so she sneaks out into the marketplace, in disguise, where she meets street urchin Aladdin. description: NYPD cop John McClane's plan to reconcile with his estranged wife is thrown for a serious loop when, minutes after he arrives at her office, the entire building is overtaken by a group of terrorists. With little help from the LAPD, wisecracking McClane sets out to single-handedly rescue the hostages and bring the bad guys down.

clues.LEVEL_1: NYPD cop John McClane's plan to reconcile with his estranged wife is thrown for a serious loop when, minutes after he arrives at her office, the entire building is overtaken by a group of terrorists. description: A narcissistic TV weatherman, along with his attractive-but-distant producer, and his mawkish cameraman, is sent to report on Groundhog Day in the small town of Punxsutawney, where he finds himself repeating the same day over and over.

clues.LEVEL_1: A narcissistic TV weatherman, along with his attractive-but-distant producer, and his mawkish cameraman, is sent to report on Groundhog Day in the small town of Punxsutawney, where he finds himself repeating the same day over and over.

description: Every second of every day, from the moment he was born, for the last thirty years, Truman Burbank has been the unwitting star of the longest running, most popular documentary-soap opera in history. The picture-perfect town of Seahaven that he calls home is actually a gigantic soundstage. Truman's friends and family - everyone he meets, in fact - are actors. He lives every moment under the unblinking gaze of thousands of hidden TV cameras.

clues.LEVEL_1: Every second of every day, from the moment he was born, for the last thirty years, Truman Burbank has been the unwitting star of the longest running, most popular documentary-soap opera in history. clues.LEVEL_2: An ordinary man begins to suspect that his entire life is a television production, with actors playing his family and friends.

description: 70-year-old widower Ben Whittaker has discovered that retirement isn't all it's cracked up to be. Seizing an opportunity to get back in the game, he becomes a senior intern at an online fashion site, founded and run by Jules Ostin.

description: The untold story of Katherine G. Johnson, Dorothy Vaughan and Mary Jackson – brilliant African-American women working at NASA and serving as the brains behind one of the greatest operations in history – the launch of astronaut John Glenn into orbit. The visionary trio crossed all gender and race lines to inspire generations to dream big.

description: When Jesper distinguishes himself as the Postal Academy's worst student, he is sent to Smeerensburg, a small village located on an icy island above the Arctic Circle, where grumpy inhabitants barely exchange words, let alone letters. Jesper is about to give up and abandon his duty as a postman when he meets local teacher Alva and Klaus, a mysterious carpenter who lives alone in a cabin full of handmade toys.
